==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I stumble upon a red book. The book is a collection of superhero stories. Most of the stories seem like they are made for kids, but one of them seems to be surprisingly mature.

It takes place in a retro futuristic version of the 1950s. Mechanical suits have been invented that grant their wearers artificial superpowers. The story follows two female heroes who have fallen in love.

Their love isn't accepted by society. When a bigoted politician's house catches fire, one woman uses her aero kinetic powers to destroy the house with a tornado. No one believes that this was an accident and the woman is arrested by her lover for committing such a vengeful act.
